definitions.explanation: A spiny marine animal whose gonads (roe) are considered a delicacy in Japanese cuisine.

examples.japanese: うにの{寿司|すし}が{好|す}きだ。
{新鮮|しんせん}なうにを{食|た}べた。
{北海道|ほっかいどう}はうにの{産地|さんち}として{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: Hokkaido is famous as a sea urchin producing region.

notes:
Also written as {雲丹|うに} or {海胆|うに}. Usually written in hiragana.

In sushi restaurants, うに refers specifically to the edible gonads (roe) of the sea urchin.

COMMON DISHES:
- うに{丼|どん}: sea urchin rice bowl
- うに{軍艦|ぐんかん}: sea urchin battleship sushi
- うに{パスタ|ぱすた}: sea urchin pasta
